purpose: Resize M108 paper execution-readiness ticket drafts to fit read-only IBKR account equity and cash budgets before applying the account-backed portfolio gate.

interpretation.status: M111 turns M110's zero-account-backed approvals into 25 account-sized paper approvals.
interpretation.finding: The fixed ticket size was the M110 blocker. Smaller account-scaled stock tickets fit the read-only account budget, while option tickets remain blocked when one minimum contract exceeds the account risk cap.
interpretation.human_review_note: Approved tickets are still human-review items because fractional-share support, short exposure, and account-specific execution permissions must be confirmed before any order-capable layer.
interpretation.recommendation: Next milestone should add pre-trade order preview/margin what-if diagnostics or a paper-only ticket review queue, still without transmitting live orders.
